news.title: Xero stock faces November 12 results as recovery debate intensifies

roles.title: Lead Product Manager – Payments Risk
roles.location: US: San Mateo (1875 South Grant Street)

bullets: Develop reusable capabilities for risk decisioning, rules, signals, limits, monitoring, alerts and case management.
Partner with Engineering and Data on APIs, data models, architecture and decisioning systems required to operate risk at scale.
Design capabilities that can support multiple processors, payment methods and markets.
Evaluate build-versus-partner decisions and determine where Xero should own risk capabilities versus rely on processors or specialist risk providers.
